a.lede: ​Attackers are now actively exploiting a high-severity vulnerability in Zyxel GS1900 series switches, according to the U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA). [...]
a.title: CISA orders feds to patch Zyxel flaw exploited for data theft

b.lede: ​The U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) warned federal agencies on Wednesday that ransomware gangs are now also exploiting a critical JetBrains TeamCity vulnerability patched in July. [...]
b.title: CISA: Ransomware gangs now exploiting critical TeamCity flaw
